markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (97%)** · Confident · Careful review

Conformal set, MUSK agreement and 4 of 5 neighbors support it, yet regions 5, 9, 10 score high for invasive. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 97%, Invasive 3% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | Nearest is Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Intraductal atypia** (regions 0, 2, 5) · ↓ invasive · Score above typical; fits a duct-confined process [F2] · Weak
- **Necrosis** (regions 5, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score, but spot check mostly rejected it · Unreliable
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score; small push toward invasive · Validated
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 9) · context · Above-typical TIL score; descriptive only [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown faithful; necrosis is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- The image is a JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section; the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Regions 5, 9, 10 score high for invasive; the whole-image call may average that away.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9, 10:** Per-region invasive scores are 97%, 96%, 89%; look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 5, 7, 11:** Confirm whether necrosis is truly present; its spot check was poor.
3. **Regions 0, 2, 5:** Confirm atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
